description: Reads a request and says which category and safety tier it falls in, and whether checked businesses that fit are signed up near the place. When the kind of business is unclear it returns needsDetail with a question and choices for the person. Contacts no one and returns no contact details. No sign-in needed.

category.description: Optional. A category slug from /v1/categories that the person picked, for example after a needs_detail question. Without it, CAR reads the request.

where.description: City and two-letter US state, e.g. "Tampa, FL"

name: car_find_business
title: Check what CAR can do for a request
